'''N0-HX''' was an [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] that worked for Agent [[Fauler]] of the [[Republic Strategic Information Service]]. N0 worked as a messenger for Fauler during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], when the agent was stationed on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. Fauler used N0-HX to contact a Republic-allied individual and asked for their help on an issue with a doomsday device dealing with [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka]].<ref name="TORLocation" />

==Behind the scenes==
N0-HX was created for ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] released by [[BioWare]] on [[December 20]], [[2011]]. It contacts Republic players as they are leaving the spaceport, starting the Czerka Corp bonus series of missions.<ref name="TORLocation" />
